note: Leads are not verified parsers. Ranks are assigned only among verified paths.

leads.name: sql-formatter
leads.reason: Formatter that returns text; no syntax tree.

leads.name: node-sql-parser
leads.reason: new Parser().astify(sql, {database}) returns an AST (type select/insert, from, columns, where, groupby, orderby).

leads.name: libpg-query
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)
leads.reason: parse(sql) returns the PostgreSQL parse tree from a WASM build of libpg_query. Not selected in this round: the parser runs as libpg_query compiled to WebAssembly, and Node V8 coverage does not report C source lines inside the module, so the parser-source coverage gate cannot be met with the JavaScript harness pattern.

leads.name: pgsql-ast-parser
leads.reason: parse(sql) returns a typed AST (select/insert statements) from its own nearley grammar.

leads.name: pg-query-emscripten
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)

leads.name: sql-parser-cst
leads.reason: parse(sql, {dialect}) returns a concrete syntax tree.

leads.name: dt-sql-parser
leads.reason: ANTLR4-based parsers per dialect, returning ANTLR parse trees.

leads.name: @appland/sql-parser
leads.reason: AppLand-maintained fork of sqlite-parser (1.5.1, 2022) with a modified PEG.js grammar and the same AST shape. Not byte-identical: the minified generated parser is 127,259 bytes against 109,981, and about 51% of sqlite-parser 1.0.1's statement fragments occur unchanged in it (43% of the fork's); the wrapper files differ only in the version banner.

leads.name: @pgsql/parser
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)

leads.name: pg-query-parser
leads.family: PostgreSQL grammar (libpg_query extraction of the PostgreSQL server parser)

leads.name: sqllens
leads.family: sqllens ANTLR4 grammars (PostgreSQL grammar forked from antlr/grammars-v4)
leads.reason: parse(sql, dialect) returns {ast, errors, cst}; the lowered IR marks INSERT as unsupported, so the summary is read from the documented CST (full ANTLR4 parse tree).

leads.name: rawsql-ts
leads.family: rawsql-ts hand-written tokenizer and recursive-descent parser
leads.reason: SqlParser.parse / parseMany return typed query models (SimpleSelectQuery, InsertQuery with a ValuesQuery).
